title: One of the more perplexing aspects of these dreams from my perspective is the reason for the almost ubiquitous reports of problematic bathrooms. I think I might have an explanation for this.

classification.theory_summary: Links a philosophy paper and proposes that ubiquitous problematic bathrooms in Mall World dreams may relate to collective unconscious testing/flagging structural issues in our conception of reality; includes ideas of an 'immune system' for a conscious universe and 'trans-temporal echolocation' guiding away from dystopias.
classification.skip_reason: No first-person dream narrative or describable dream locations/events; only theory/speculation about why bathrooms appear in reports.

meta.author_theory: Collective (un)conscious may use dream motifs (problematic bathrooms) to test/flag conceptual problems before ideas manifest; humans as immune-system-like agents for an evolving mental domain; 'trans-temporal echolocation' toward better timelines.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post contains no phenomenological description (no specific bathrooms, layouts, lighting, crowds, emotions in-dream, or events). Only mentions the general motif of 'problematic bathrooms' as commonly reported by others and provides a theoretical explanation plus an external link.
